structural_change: S81-ELEM2-RG3 10-21 17:30: GPL-0305 fix. Parent kit gates (rg3 514252/514255 @7bd692ad2 pve1; nq db28b4264 ep5) all failed/diverged the same way: std-cell util 2% of placeable (hard 733k um2, std 8k), routability loop never below overflow 0.3 because every routability iteration reverts to a snapshot (overflow oscillates 0.3-0.5), top-0.5% congestion only 1.04-1.07, then after 'Routability finished. Reverting to minimal observed congestion' HPWL jumps 5e6 -> 8.5e7 and the density penalty grows 1e-5 -> 1e29 -> NaN. Not a density/geometry squeeze (2% util, reach-safe relay hops kept). Fix = the established cure for this signature (hbm_su_cx_dls/dlq/rcq, TW5-PGSTREAM, dsfd_vm_static_wfc_ctl r4/r5): GPL_ROUTABILITY_DRIVEN=0; congestion left to GRT. Geometry, RTL, pins identical to the parent kit. Parent: s81dv_idxrg3nqb. TOK-FUNC2-IDX_RG3_NQ 10-21: chain-end variant of the s81dv_idxrg3b kit (S81-COLLECT2/L20KIT reach-safe successor 7bd692ad2, same outline, macro/child lattice, pin spans and recipe). Top dsdv_idx_rg3_nq wraps dsdv_idx_rg3 (u_rg3, defaults OH=2 RH=2) with qo inside: the qo pin/relay flops have no consumer and are removed by synthesis (dv_bind chain_end rule). E face = so/st only. Inherited: S81-COLLECT2/L20KIT 10-21 (MU.S81.L20.KIT): predecessor gate (S81-IDXRD 7dc7fbf3b, native PASS max32) died in GPL-0305 after timing-driven repair (19,249 buffers / 5,371 long wires, slack -425 ps) + routability inflation (top-0.5% congestion 1.76): ~1 mm unregistered spans inside the kit. Structural fix, reach <= 405 um: RTL OH=2 kept relay hops on the W->E qo/so pass-through (513+276 b, 3 segments ~345 um) and RH=2 kept relay hops from the N-face rri pin flops to the landing logic; SRAM column reordered so the 8 landing macros sit at the top under the rri pins (y 475-1181; queues sq/mq bottom beside the chunk tails, iq/lm middle); rri pins pinned to x 97.2-691.2 over the SRAM column, rqo 0-86.4. Cost +2 edges a reader on the q/s chains, +2 on the response lane (static; T0 absorbs). Parallel fallback 1036.8 x 1252.8 (taller top channel 198.7, wider rri span).
